changelog.v1_1_0: Added full support for Italian language (Italiano).
changelog.v1_1_1: New highly optimized i18n engine based on JSON files in locales/ (~65% faster compilation).
changelog.v1_1_2: Native direct CAT protocol for Kenwood / Elecraft / Yaesu (commands FA, FB, MD, TX, SM, FT).
changelog.v1_1_3: Full compliance with ADIF 3 standard in UTF-8 (field length in bytes) for LoTW/TQSL and ClubLog.
changelog.v1_1_4: Precise Sun and Greyline position calculation with Equation of Time.
changelog.v1_1_5: Fixed UTC timestamp decoding from WSJT-X / JTDX binary UDP packets.
changelog.v1_1_6: Extension of 160m band (from 1800 kHz) and addition of 13cm/3cm microwave bands for QO-100 satellite.
changelog.v1_1_7: Improved DUPE logic for Mixed contacts and per-band multiplier scoring in contests.
changelog.v1_1_8: env_logger initialization and UI loop optimization for Cloud Auto-Upload queue.
changelog.v1_0_3_1: Redesigned color themes with colorblind-friendly palette (Okabe-Ito).
changelog.v1_0_3_2: Added operating bar, Mini HUD and distance unit selection (km/miles/NM).
changelog.v1_0_3_3: Menu reorganization, font scaling, status legend and clear error messages.
changelog.v1_0_3_4: DXCC prefix cache and propagation results cache for smoother performance.
changelog.v1_0_2_0: Shared HTTP client with retries and backoff on network errors.
changelog.v1_0_2_1: Validation of propagation calculations (VOACAP-lite) and logbook integrity.
changelog.v1_0_2_2: ADIF import/export error reporting in UI.
changelog.v1_0_1_0: Fixed critical bugs (P0) related to stability and data loss.
changelog.v1_0_1_1: Credential storage in system keyring instead of configuration file.
changelog.v1_0_1_2: Stable chronological QSO number independent of sorting and filtering.
changelog.v1_0_0_0: First release of SPLogbook — modern ham radio logbook.
changelog.v1_0_0_1: Integration with Hamlib, TCI, WSJT-X, QRZ, HamQTH, eQSL, LoTW and Club Log.
